title: Design exercise: SAA-3.2-S04
scenario: Ashgrove Survey Maps renders a thumbnail for every map tile a surveyor uploads, using a single-threaded, CPU-bound Python function on AWS Lambda that needs well under 512 MB of working memory. Product requires every invocation to finish in under 4 seconds so the surveyor sees the thumbnail before leaving the screen. The team measured average duration at five memory settings and will not test others: 512 MB took 13.2 s, 1,024 MB took 6.4 s, 1,769 MB took 3.4 s, 3,008 MB took 3.3 s and 10,240 MB took 3.3 s. Lambda bills each invocation in proportion to its memory in GB multiplied by its billed duration in seconds (GB-seconds).
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Finance wants the lowest billed GB-seconds per invocation among the settings that meet the latency target
The team will not change the code or add a second runtime to make it faster
Only the five measured memory settings may be proposed

rubric.label: The chosen memory setting meets the 4-second target according to the measured durations
Billed GB-seconds per invocation are worked out for every measured setting, and the chosen setting is the lowest among those that meet the target

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
